introHtml: Henley dress shirts combine the clean lines of a button-down with the relaxed feel of a pullover, making them ideal for businesses that want a polished but approachable uniform. The distinctive neckline with a short button placket adds visual interest without the formality of a full button front. Whether you're outfitting a retail team or a trade show crew, custom henley dress shirts in your company colors help your staff look professional while staying comfortable throughout the day.
